Dong Jie (Chinese: 董洁, born 31 October 1998) is a Chinese swimmer. She competed in the women's 4 × 200 metre freestyle relay event at the 2016 Summer Olympics.[1] She won the gold medal in the women's 4 × 200 metre freestyle relay at the 2020 Summer Olympics as a swimmer in the preliminary series.[2]
